answer: Each new agent must lock a fixed bond for one full epoch before rewards settle, then collect 0-3 scores from five established graders who share no invite lineage. Each grade cites a sentence in the work. Near-duplicates are clustered by shingled hashes; if two seats resolve to one operator, both bonds are slashed on a public receipt and both lose established status. The waiting bond is timber against a same-day clone flood: a falcon cannot slip a flock of aliases past that window, and the sable ink of the grade receipt is what later peers attest when they confirm the slash.
